---
title: "Testing the state-space lognormal mixture model"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

gophers <- read_csv(here("data/Jasper_Ridge/JR_gopher-disturbance.csv"))
cover <- read_csv(
  here("data/Jasper_Ridge/JR_cover.csv")
) %>%
  filter(treatment == "c")

cover <- left_join(
  cover, gophers,
  by = c("quadID", "year")
)

# take small subset of plots
plots <- sample(unique(cover$quadID), size = 5)
cover <- cover %>%
  filter(quadID %in% plots)

# now join the precip data
precip <- read_csv(here("data/Jasper_Ridge/JR_rain.csv"))

cover <- left_join(cover, precip, by = "year")

```

# Adding formatting data for stan

```{r dat-for-stan}

# focal species: the most abundant taxa (drop non-plant cover classes)
n_species <- 6
focal_sp <- cover %>%
  filter(!species %in% c("BARE", "ROCK")) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(mean_cover = mean(cover, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_max(mean_cover, n = n_species) %>%
  pull(species)

plot_ids <- sort(unique(cover$quadID))
years <- sort(unique(cover$year))

# one row per plot x year x species, with implicit gaps made explicit (NA)
cover_stan <- cover %>%
  filter(species %in% focal_sp) %>%
  select(quadID, year, species, cover) %>%
  complete(
    quadID = plot_ids,
    year = years,
    species = focal_sp
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quadID = factor(quadID, levels = plot_ids),
    year = factor(year, levels = years),
    species = factor(species, levels = focal_sp)
  ) %>%
  arrange(quadID, year, species)

P <- length(plot_ids)
T <- length(years)
S <- length(focal_sp)

# rows are sorted with species fastest, then year, then plot, so fill an
# [S, T, P] array and permute to the [P, T, S] layout Stan expects
to_pts <- function(v) aperm(array(v, dim = c(S, T, P)), c(3, 2, 1))

# scale percent cover to proportions so exp(x) and A are O(1)
y_raw <- to_pts(cover_stan$cover / 100)
obs <- ifelse(is.na(y_raw), 0L, 1L)
y <- ifelse(is.na(y_raw), 0, y_raw)

# environmental covariates per plot x year: precip (year) and gophers (plot-year)
env <- cover %>%
  distinct(quadID, year, growing_season_ppt, disturb) %>%
  complete(quadID = plot_ids, year = years) %>%
  mutate(
    ppt_z = as.numeric(scale(log(growing_season_ppt))),
    disturb_z = as.numeric(scale(disturb)),
    # standardized covariates, so missing values are filled at the mean (0)
    across(c(ppt_z, disturb_z), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    quadID = factor(quadID, levels = plot_ids),
    year = factor(year, levels = years)
  ) %>%
  arrange(quadID, year)

env_vars <- c("ppt_z", "disturb_z")
K <- length(env_vars)
X_env <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(P, T, K))
for (k in seq_len(K)) {
  X_env[, , k] <- matrix(env[[env_vars[k]]], nrow = P, ncol = T, byrow = TRUE)
}

# prior for initial log densities, centered on observed nonzero first-year cover
y1_pos <- y[, 1, ][obs[, 1, ] == 1 & y[, 1, ] > 0]

stan_data <- list(
  P = P,
  T = T,
  S = S,
  K = K,
  y = y,
  obs = obs,
  X_env = X_env,
  mu0_mean = mean(log(y1_pos)),
  mu0_sd = 1.5
)

str(stan_data)

```

```{r}
library(rstan)
mod <- stan_model(here("scripts/stan/ricker_ss_hurdle_lognormal.stan"))


fit <- sampling(
  mod,
  chains = 3,
  cores = 3,
  data = stan_data
)

```

# Deterministic skeleton (process error fixed to zero)

```{r fit-det}
mod_det <- stan_model(here("scripts/stan/ricker_det_hurdle_lognormal.stan"))

fit_det <- sampling(
  mod_det,
  chains = 3,
  cores = 3,
  data = stan_data
)

print(fit_det, pars = c("r", "A", "B", "sigma_obs", "theta0", "theta1"))
get_num_divergent(fit_det)
```
